title: "03 — Acquisition"
format: html
---

## Goal

Acquire only frozen provider/product/version × HCS-domain combinations using reproducible `oceancube` calls.

## Required outputs per acquisition

- exact request parameters;
- provider/product/dataset IDs;
- requested and returned spatial/temporal extents;
- local raw path;
- file size;
- SHA-256 checksum;
- acquisition timestamp;
- provider response/status;
- catalog update.

## Rules

- Write provider-native files only to `cin/raw/`.
- Never overwrite an existing raw artifact silently.
- Re-downloads with different content require a new provenance record.
- Authentication credentials remain outside Git.

## Status

**STOP until `01_domain` and `02_product_registry` are frozen.**
